messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — were kicking off a multi-arm canary tomorrow for the new model bring-up (mistral-x2 7B, trying two quant configs + kv-cache variant). Need coordination on promptset, dedupe, golden labels, and labeler schedule. Target: measure quality/regression vs prod on our holdout and the benchmark suite.

sam: Got it. How big are we thinking for seed + canary samples?

anya: Aim for 6k eval dialogs total (1.5k per arm) + a 500-example golden set for manual review (edgecases + longctx). Holdout/bench will be the standard longprompt + convo subsets.

marta: We can staff labeling: 4 labelers for 3 days (can start after you drop the seed). We'll need a golden labeling guide update — any new failure modes to highlight?

anya: Yes — call out long-prefetch hallucination, enum-order sensitivity, and instruction-following degradation. Also include a short checklist: reproducible prompt, exact model/quant name, seed id.

leo: Before labels, Ill run fuzzy dedupe + deid pass and output a fingerprint map. Please run this on the seed to avoid labeler churn. Example dedupe command I use: 

```
./tools/dedupe --input canary_seed.ndjson --threshold 0.84 --out canary_dedupe_report.json
```

lea: (typo: meant leo).

sam: Ill generate the 6k samples across arms tonight. Plan: 1. generate with identical prompts 2. store output with model/quant metadata 3. attach tokenization/latency stats. Output dir: s3://redwood-canaries/mistral-x2/170942.

labeler-bot: Created task LBL-4422: "Canary golden labeling (mistral-x2)" — assigned to @marta + team.

marta: Received LBL-4422. Please upload the initial 500 golden examples (post-dedupe) and the guide. Well priority label the 500 then sample 200 from each arm for adjudication.

anya: Config snippet for routing were planning (will set sample_rate low and balanced arms):

```
canary:
  sample_rate: 0.005
  arms:
    - name: int8-baseline
      weight: 0.25
    - name: int4-optim
      weight: 0.25
    - name: int8-kvcache
      weight: 0.25
    - name: prod-fallback
      weight: 0.25
```

leo: Also adding a quick quality smoke: compute embedding-sim recall between arms and prod and flag > 5% drop. Ill push the metric job.

sam: ETA for artifacts: generation + metadata by 06:00 PT. Ill attach the s3 path in the thread when done.

anya: Perfect. Last ask: export dedupe report + a short CSV of examples that changed between quant variants (paraphrase or truncation) so labelers can focus. Link to guide & upload: https://drive.redwood/inference/canary/mistral-x2/170942 (private). Meeting to sync: canary standup tomorrow 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup: well be standing by to start labels once you drop the post-dedupe seed.
